q: How does a garment factory in Kenya's Athi River EPZ report diesel backup alongside grid power?
title: Athi River EPZ: diesel and grid
short: Grid power is Scope 2 at Kenya's factor, which is low because most power comes from geothermal, hydro and wind. Diesel burnt in your own generators is Scope 1 at about 2.68 kg CO2 per litre. Report both separately so a brand can see how much outages cost in emissions.
audience: Apparel exporters in Athi River, Mombasa and other Kenyan export zones

ul: Grid kWh from bills times the Kenyan factor: Scope 2.
Litres of diesel times 2.68 kg CO2 per litre: Scope 1.

p: On a clean grid, a week of diesel can outweigh a month of grid power. Showing it makes a case for a battery or solar backup.
Power bills, generator fuel receipts and run hour logs.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity, fuel and boiler invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record per factory, so the figures a brand asks for can be traced back to the bills.

example.title: Worked example: one month
lines: Grid: 60,000 kWh x 0.1 (assumed Kenyan factor) = 6,000 kg CO2, Scope 2
Diesel: 4,000 L x 2.68 = 10,720 kg CO2, Scope 1
Diesel is 64% of the month's total: 10,720 / 16,720
example.note: The grid factor here is an assumption for illustration. Use the official or IEA figure for the year.
